title: eludite.editor.remove_and_sort_usings output
description: What Remove and Sort Usings did.

state.description: `done` when the command finished; `running` while a language server request is in flight (an agent polls until done, up to 5 seconds); `picker` when a picker opened for the person to choose; `failed` when nothing was applied (see `message`).

column.description: The caret's column afterwards (1-based, in characters).

message.description: Why nothing was applied, or a note on what was.
